assembled_text: One documentary photograph that fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge, a single still image; no black bars, no letterbox, no borders. Early Silla, Gyeongju, 5th century: the whole Cheonmachong burial work area at an early construction stage, seen from a higher position. In the middle of the frame, the rectangular wooden outer burial chamber of thick timber beams, about 6.6 by 4.2 metres, open-topped with no lid and empty on top; a low course of river stones lines its outer walls and nothing covers it; no earth mound has been raised yet. Around it, many small figures work in an organised way: at the left a timber yard where labourers shape beams, across the middle ground lines of labourers carry river stones in straw baskets on shoulder poles toward the chamber, near the chamber a few set stones along its outer walls. Everyone in the image is a labourer in undyed coarse hemp short jackets to hip length wrapped right over left with cloth waist cords, narrow trousers bound at the shin, straw sandals or bare feet; colours only natural off-white, raw fibre and a few black jackets. Every labourer is a clearly different individual: mixed ages from about 20 to 45, different face shapes and skin tones from sun, some clean-shaven, some with short stubble, only a few with beards; different heights and builds from thin to stocky; some with a cloth headband, some with a bare topknot; no two people look alike, no repeated or cloned faces, no hero figure. Tools only: straw baskets, rope, shoulder poles, wooden mallets, wooden wedges and all-wooden spades. Every tool is made entirely of wood: no metal blades, no metal heads, no saws, no axes, no pick-axes, no measuring tapes, nothing yellow or modern in anyone's hands. In the far background only bare low hills, open untilled land and a few trees: no utility poles, no power lines, no buildings, no greenhouses, no roads, no regular field grid. No one looks at the camera, no one poses. Camera about 2.2 metres high, slightly above the workers, 24mm lens feel, static high wide view taking in the whole work area with open ground on all sides, overcast daylight, dust in the air. Photorealistic historical documentary still, style B Documentary Reenactment, natural textures and skin, not glossy, earthy natural colours. No tiled roofs, no stone walls, no modern objects, no rubber wheels, no cranes, no gold objects visible, no crown visible, no text, no watermark, no logo.
